name: Midas Golden Touch - Reborn
review:
A refresh of the original 15-line Midas game, with multiplier wilds, a feature buy and a bonus game where wins stick.

It keeps the classic three-row layout and gold-drenched castle, now with a feature buy for impatient players. High volatility, 10,100x cap, 96.17% RTP. The best-value Midas game, with a stronger RTP than the sequels.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
